notes: Universal Robina Corporation (PSE: URC) — JG Summit Holdings flagship food & beverage company, the largest Philippine-based branded food company. Two main businesses: (1) Branded Consumer Foods (BCFG) — snacks, beverages (C2 RTD tea, Refresh juices), candies, biscuits, instant noodles (Nissin partnership), pet food, ice cream — operates in Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Australia/NZ (Griffin's, Unifoods, Snack Brands Aus.); (2) Agro-Industrial & Commodities (AIC) — sugar milling (URSUMCO, SONEDCO, CARSUMCO, BISUMCO), flour milling, animal feeds & livestock (hogs, poultry). Fiscal year ends Dec 31. All values in PHP millions. Source: SEC Philippines 17-A annual reports + audited consolidated financial statements. Sector: Diversified Agribusiness (sugar/livestock + branded foods). PHP/USD ~58. Share count ~2,204M.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue PHP 134.2B. EBITDA PHP 18.2B. NI PHP 8.23B. COVID hit — at-home consumption boost on snacks offset by HoReCa weakness. Sugar segment soft on global price weakness.
FY21: revenue PHP 132.7B (-1%). EBITDA PHP 16.7B. NI PHP 7.09B. Continued mobility restrictions in PH; BCFG margins squeezed by input inflation.
FY22: revenue PHP 148.8B (+12%). EBITDA PHP 16.9B. NI PHP 7.92B. Reopening + price increases lifted top-line; sugar prices recovered.
FY23: revenue PHP 159.1B (+7%). EBITDA PHP 18.5B (+9%). NI PHP 11.5B (+45%). Strong year on PH sugar price spike + branded foods volume + price.
FY24: revenue PHP 167B (+5%). EBITDA PHP 19.5B (+5%). NI PHP 9.92B (-14% YoY off elevated FY23 base). Sugar margins normalized; branded foods steady.
